messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a good wash (soft cloth, mild soap), remove dust from inside the soundhole, and tune it to standard pitch. | A clean, well‑tuned instrument looks cared for and gives buyers confidence. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | • Use natural light (avoid harsh shadows).
• Capture front, back, side, headstock, bridge, and any visible wear.
• Include a reference object (e.g., a coin or a ruler) for scale. | Great photos attract more views and reduce buyer hesitation. | | **3. Write a Detailed Description** | • Brand, model, year, wood type, finish, serial number, and any modifications.
• Mention any scratches, dents, or repairs.
• State the tuning and overall playability. | Transparency builds trust and reduces post‑sale disputes. | | **4. Research Comparable Listings** | Search eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music shops for similar models in your area. | Helps set a realistic asking price and shows you’re informed. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage/handmade), Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace.
• **Local Music Stores** – Many accept consignment or direct sales.
• **Community Boards** – University bulletin boards, local community centers. | Diversifying platforms increases exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target price to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; starting high gives you flexibility. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • If shipping, use a sturdy case or gig bag, pack with bubble wrap, and choose a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS).
• For local pickup, meet in a public place (coffee shop, library) and bring a friend if possible. | Shipping protects the instrument; local pickup saves costs and speeds the sale. | | **8. Handle Payment Securely** | • For online sales, use PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo (with a receipt), or a bank transfer.
• For cash, verify the amount before handing over the guitar. | Protects against fraud and ensures you receive full payment. | | **9. Prepare a Bill of Sale** | Include buyer’s name, seller’s name, instrument details, sale price, date, and both signatures. | Provides legal documentation and protects both parties. | | **10. Follow Up & Close the Deal** | • Confirm receipt of payment before shipping.
• Keep a copy of all correspondence and receipts. | Ensures a smooth transaction and helps resolve any future issues. | ### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Tip | Explanation | |-----|-------------| | **Avoid “Too Good to Be True” Offers** | If someone offers far above market value or wants to pay via wire transfer, be cautious. | | **Check Serial Numbers** | Verify authenticity on the manufacturer’s website or through a trusted database. | | **Be Honest About Condition** | Over‑promising can lead to returns or negative reviews. | | **Use a Gig Bag or Case** | Even if you’re not shipping, having a protective case ready shows you’ve maintained the instrument. | | **Consider Consignment** | Some stores will hold the guitar for a period and take a commission once sold. | | **Offer a Return Window** | A short return policy (e.g., 48 hours) can increase buyer confidence. | --- #### Sample Listing Template (Reverb) ``` Title: 2005 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand: Yamaha - Model: FG800 - Year: 2005 - Wood: Spruce top, mahogany back & sides - Finish: Natural - Serial #: 12345678 - Tuning: Standard EADGBE - Condition: Minor scratches on the back, no cracks or loose strings - Extras: Included original case, extra strings, and a cleaning kit Price: $350 (Negotiable) Shipping: Will ship within 3 days of payment via UPS Ground ($15). Local pickup available. Payment: PayPal Goods & Services preferred. Please contact me with any questions. Thank you for looking! ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your chosen platform. Good luck with your sale!
